description: Use when someone asks what size curtains, curtain pole or track to buy, how high to hang a curtain pole, or which UK ready-made curtain size fits a window. Returns the pole’s length and height, the ready-made pair and the made-to-measure sizes.

ceiling_height_cm.description: The ceiling’s height from the floor (cm).

fullness.description: The curtains’ total flat width ÷ the pole’s length; default the heading’s usual (2, or 1.5 for tab top).

heading.description: The curtain heading: eyelet, pencil_pleat or tab_top.

length.description: Where the hem ends: sill, below_sill, floor or puddle (on the floor).

sill_height_cm.description: The sill’s height from the floor (cm).

window_height_cm.description: The window’s height, outside the frame (cm).

window_width_cm.description: The window’s width, outside the frame (cm).

name: curtain_size

above_window_cm.description: (negative: below the window top, when the ceiling leaves no room)

glass_covered_cm.description: How much glass each stack covers

hem_at.description: The length used (below_sill becomes floor when the sill is low)

hem_cm.description: The hem from the floor (negative: on the floor, puddled)

overhang_cm.description: The pole past each side of the window

pole_top_cm.description: The pole’s top from the floor

ready_made.description: The UK ready-made pair: name, width_cm, drop_cm, width_in, drop_in, shorten_cm, fullness

ring_eye_cm.description: Where the drop is measured from, below the pole top

room_above.description: ok, tight or none: the room above the window for a pole

two_thirds_cm.description: Two thirds of the way to the ceiling
